issues.title: Circular/Self-Referential Acceptance Criteria
issues.why: AC-01 through AC-05 in 97-acceptance-criteria.md define 'structural rules' for the module itself but lack 'Verifies' clauses that point to external code/scripts for the specific module logic (e.g., the linter authoring guide in file 27).
issues.fix: Add 'Verifies' clauses to AC-01..05 citing specific linter-script paths and expected exit codes for this module's unique content.

issues.title: Missing Worked Examples for Consolidated Format
issues.why: While the spec defines what a 'consolidated' file is, it lacks a concrete 'before/after' example showing how a 50-page source spec is condensed into a 5-page consolidated reference.
issues.fix: Add a 'Worked Example' section to 00-overview.md showing a source-to-consolidated mapping for a specific module like '03-error-manage'.

issues.title: Aspirational Folder References
issues.why: The spec acknowledges references to folders that 'do not yet materialize' (e.g., 08-docs-viewer-ui), which creates a 100% confidence failure for an AI trying to validate the tree.
issues.fix: Mark aspirational references with a standardized [STUB] prefix in the inventory tables to signal they are not yet implementable.
